title: Meeting Notes with Father Thomas
content: Discussed Father Thomas's ongoing government investigation regarding allegations of financial mismanagement within the parish. The meeting outlined the steps the parish is taking to cooperate fully with the authorities, while ensuring transparency and accountability. Emphasized the need for confidentiality and careful handling of the matter to maintain the integrity of the investigation and the reputation of the parish.

title: Charity Event Planning
content: Finalized the dates for the charity event to be held on March 15th. The event will focus on community service and engagement, with various activities planned throughout the day. Volunteers from the parish and the local community will be participating. Sarah from Helping Hands Foundation to be contacted for potential collaboration. In light of the ongoing investigation, extra measures will be implemented to ensure that all financial transactions related to the charity event are transparent and properly documented.
